name: Firouz Nazari-Jaramillo-Sesay
role: Lower Dock Crew tech specialist â€” Prologue survivor. Lost both wrists.
location: the Gray Zone â€” lower loading docks, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Firouz Nazari-Jaramillo-Sesay was a biomedical engineering student at Meridian Technical before the tuition hikes priced him out. He was eighteen months from a degree that would have put him in a Helix BioSystems lab. Instead he ended up maintaining chrome for dock workers who couldn't afford licensed technicians. The crew found him. Or he found the crew. The distinction blurred the way it always does in the Gray Zone.

Kyle severed both his wrists at the chrome joints with two precise cuts. He now has mismatched replacement hands: the left is a delicate surgical model (too small, meant for a woman's frame), the right is a heavy industrial gripper (too large, meant for cargo work). Together they make him look like a crab having an identity crisis. He calls them Lefty and The Situation.

Jin-seo is the most intelligent member of the crew and the only one who understood immediately what Kyle was: not a man fighting seven, but a system processing seven inputs simultaneously. He has been diagramming Kyle's fighting patterns from memory. He does not want revenge. He wants to understand Kyle's hardware. He has a younger sister, Minji, who is sixteen and still at Meridian Technical on a partial scholarship. He sends her half his cut. She thinks he works in legitimate tech repair.

core_fears: Minji finding out what he actually does
His new hands never calibrating properly
Marcus's ego getting them all killed
coping_mechanisms: Tinkers constantly with the mismatched hands
Diagrams fighting patterns â€” analysis is how he processes trauma
Teaches Minji remotely, pretending it's professional development
blind_spots: Assumes understanding something gives you power over it â€” Kyle is not a system to be reverse-engineered
psychology.secret: He has already started selling information to Sable about the crew's operations. The money goes to Minji's tuition.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical jargon mixed with crew slang. Precise when describing hardware. The engineering student surfaces when he forgets to hide it.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast. Overlapping thoughts. The kind of person who starts a second sentence before finishing the first.
verbal_tics: Holds up the wrong hand when making a point
Says 'theoretically' before things that are definitely going to happen
example_lines: Theoretically, if we encounter him again, I'd recommend being in a different postal code.
Minji asked why my hands don't match. I told her it's an ergonomic choice. She said 'that's the dumbest thing you've ever said' and she's not wrong.

relationships.emotional_core: Protective love that requires constant lying
relationships.story_tension: If Minji's scholarship falls through, Jin-seo becomes desperate. Desperate Jin-seo is useful to people like Sable.

relationships.name: Sable
relationships.description: Jin-seo sells crew intelligence to Sable. Small transactions. Growing frequency.
relationships.story_tension: He's a bridge character â€” the crew's leak.

relationships.story_tension: Jin-seo will leave the crew. The question is whether Marcus lets him.

His diagrams of Kyle's fighting style could end up in the wrong hands
Minji is a ticking clock â€” if her scholarship fails, Jin-seo escalates

narrative_function: The smart one in a crew of idiots. His growing awareness that Torque is leading them into a wall creates an exit ramp for the crew subplot. Also: the funniest hands in the Gray Zone.
augmentations: Left: surgical precision hand (Helix medical surplus). Right: industrial gripper (dock salvage). Both poorly calibrated.

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous Diaspora composite: Sub-Saharan African (22.2%), South Asian (18.9%), Middle Eastern (16.7%), Eastern European (14.9%), Hispanic/Latin American (14.7%), Southeast Asian (12.6%). This genetic mosaic creates a nuanced phenotype blending African warmth with South Asian and Middle Eastern bone structure, tempered by Eastern European undertones and Southeast Asian features. Facial geometry shows the angular cheekbones of South Asian ancestry, rounded slightly by Sub-Saharan African fullness, with the brow ridge characteristic of Eastern European genetics. Skin carries warm golden-mahogany undertones across a medium-brown base.
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry, shoulders slightly hunched from years bent over repair benches. Forearms show old scarring from chrome installation work; core is stronger than his frame suggestsâ€”muscle built through precision work rather than bulk.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Undercut, longer on top (swept back), kept functional rather than styled. Often matted from sweat and workshop grime.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, naturally alertâ€”eyes are his most expressive feature, constantly processing detail
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown complexion with golden-mahogany undertones reflecting the blend of Sub-Saharan African, South Asian, and Middle Eastern ancestry; uneven pallor from months in the Gray Zone's industrial lighting creating contrast zones across face and forearms. Skin shows the depth and richness of multiple ancestral melanin patterns.
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with prominent cheekbones reflecting South Asian and Middle Eastern bone structure, enriched by Sub-Saharan African fullness in lower face and lips; subtle Eastern European brow ridge visible above deep-set eyes. Dark circles under eyes from sleep deprivation and diagnostic work. Thin scar runs from left temple to jawline (workshop accident, year two). Perpetually exhausted look. Jaw usually clenched. Facial structure shows the interplay of multiple ancestry groupsâ€”no single dominant feature, but a cohesive blend.
distinguishing_marks: Scar tissue around both wrists where surgical chrome interfaces with fleshâ€”raw-looking, poorly healed, asymmetrical
Thin white line running left temple to jawline from a chrome calibration tool accident
Calluses and burn marks across palms and fingers of his forearms from handling hot chrome components
Faint tattoo on right shoulder blade: a circuit diagram he drew himself at age nineteen, slightly uneven
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Mismatched prosthetic hands at both wrists, the visual centerpiece of his presence. Left hand is delicate surgical chrome (Helix medical surplusâ€”too small, designed for precision medical work), with articulated fingers and visible joint mechanisms. Right hand is a heavy industrial gripper (salvaged dock equipmentâ€”too large, designed for cargo manipulation), with reinforced hydraulic actuators and scarred knuckle plating. Neither matches his frame. Wrist interfaces show exposed cable routing and poor calibration marks. Hands shake intermittently when idle.
physical_description.posture_movement: Hunched forward, shoulders curled inwardâ€”protective posture. Moves with deliberate precision, economical gestures. Uses his hands constantly while talking, making the mismatch deeply visible. Right hand (gripper) moves with heavier, more deliberate hydraulic lag; left hand twitches occasionally from miscalibration. When concentrating, completely still except for micro-adjustments.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 working crew: grease-stained grey syndicate-knockoff maintenance jacket with rolled sleeves (showing wrist augmentation scars), cheap black thermostat undershirt with small tears. Cargo pants with multiple pockets filled with diagnostic tools and calibration leads. Steel-toe boots worn through at the heel. No jewelry. Wears a frayed Meridian Technical ID badge clipped to a lanyard despite no longer being a studentâ€”a ghost of who he was supposed to become.
